column4: click "Select Radio 3" then "Select Radio 2"; state workspace.selected == 3 then == 2 and state tunedHz follows the selected radio (the strip shows it)
expect "Radio 2: Test radio 2" label contains "Test radio 2"; the device name is text (the seam's made-up radio 2), read as the control's own label
expect "Radio 2: 101.000000 MHz" label contains "101.000000"; the frequency text of the made-up radio 2
expect "Radio 2: WFM" label contains "WFM"; the mode chip of the made-up radio 2

the four lamps carry the same words in every pane (RUN, DEC, MUTE, FAIL) so no label is unique; each lamp's state is the pane's flag, held by test_slint_radio_pane and read back as state workspace.running.<n>
click "Start Radio 3" then "Stop Radio 1"; state workspace.running.3 == 1 and workspace.running.1 == 0, the others untouched
expect "Radio 2: SPAN 2.400 MHz" and "Radio 2: GAIN --" label contains; the drop order of the figures is held by test_slint_radio_workspace (ten widths)

press "Radio 4 spectrum": click to tune retunes radio 4 only (state workspace.tuned.4 moved, .3 .2 .1 not, the selection not). Double-click, wheel, band drag, edge drag and right-click have no verb; held by test_slint_radio_workspace with real pointer events and test_slint_workspace_host

press "Radio 3 waterfall": click to tune retunes radio 3 only (state workspace.tuned.3 moved, .4 .2 not). Pan, wheel, double-click and the right-click menu have no verb; held by test_slint_radio_workspace
a pointer drag: the scripted input has no drag verb; test_slint_radio_workspace drags it with real pointer events and checks that the radio's share is kept across a page change
state workspace.selected after each selection and shot "workspace-selected-2.png"; the outline's pixels are held by test_slint_radio_workspace in both skins
shot "workspace-four.png" and "workspace-two.png" (looked at); the plot top and the picture position are held by test_slint_radio_pane
click "2 x 2", "Side by side", "One"; state workspace.layout == 2, 1, 0 and workspace.shown, workspace.cells; expect the key checked

click "Radios 5-8", "Radios 1-4", "Radios 7-8", "Radios 1-2"; state workspace.page and workspace.cells; expect the key checked; with 8 radios in layout Four only the page shown is read (workspace.ticks.5 == 0 on page one)
a 1000 x 640 window: state workspace.shown == 0 and workspace.fell == 1; expect the sentence present (its text is a label, no state of its own)

three radios in 2 x 2: state workspace.cells == "1,2,3,0" and workspace.ticks.4 == 0; shot "workspace-empty-slot.png"; the cell has no unique control label (the name is shared by a group and its text)
state workspace.cells per layout and page, workspace.pic.<n> (the pictures fitted to the pane, today's size back in One), workspace.ticks.<n> (only the radios on screen are read)
click "Controls follow Radio 2" and "Controls follow Radio 1"; state workspace.selected follows and the strip shows that radio (state tunedHz); expect the key checked
click "STOP R2": state workspace.r.2.running == 0 and radio 1 still runs; expect "STOP R2" enabled equals "false" once it has stopped
click "STOP ALL" then "START ALL": state workspace.r.<n>.running for every open radio; the key's own word changes with it
click "Radio 3 master": state workspace.selected == 3; state workspace.master.<n> is 1 running, 0 stopped, 2 failed
a tag with no label of its own (a readout); its colour is held by test_slint_radio_strip in both skins and looked at in the shots
click "Output of Radio 2" four times: state workspace.audio.2 goes left, right, none, both (fact.radio.2.audio from the engine)
click "Mute Radio 2": state workspace.mute.2 == 1 and workspace.mute.1 == 0
click "Solo Radio 2" twice: state workspace.solo == 2 then 0; expect the key checked (the host's own record)
slider "Radio 2: VOLUME": state workspace.r.2.volume follows, workspace.r.1.volume does not

state workspace.chips == "1,2,3" (one chip per open radio, in front of today's); the chip's own label carries its radio's frequency, which a script cannot name, so a click on a chip is held by test_slint_host_radio_mix (the chip's words) and looked at in the shots
click "Add Signal generator" in an empty cell: state workspace.radios grows, the cell becomes a pane; the engine's refusal when the limit is reached: state workspace.addnote
click "Add a radio" in the status bar: the sheet opens (state workspace.open == 1), "Add Signal generator"#2 adds, the sheet closes
click "Remove Radio 2" on a stopped radio: gone at once (state workspace.radios); on a running one the question comes first (state workspace.removeask == 2)
click "Remove" in the question: the radio goes; "Cancel": it stays

click "Select Radio 6" on page two of eight LIVE radios: state workspace.selected == 6 (RADIO_FOCUS to the real engine); live-two: "Select Radio 2" and the strip follows (state tunedHz differs from radio 1's)
click "Stop Radio 4" / "Start Radio 4" with four LIVE radios: state workspace.r.4.running follows, radios 1 to 3 untouched
press "Radio 3 waterfall" with four LIVE radios: state workspace.r.3.tuned moves, r.1 r.2 r.4 do not, the selection stays (live-two: the same for radio 2)
click "2 x 2" with radios opened by the real RADIO_ADD: state workspace.cells == "1,2,3,4"; live-eight: "Side by side" gives four pages
click "Radios 5-8" with eight LIVE radios: state workspace.cells == "5,6,7,8", each pane's own tone (state workspace.peakoff.<n>)
radio remove 3 (the real RADIO_REMOVE): state workspace.cells == "1,2,0,4", the other panes still read their own tones; live-eight: radio 7 removed on page two
state workspace.peakoff.<n> per pane (radio n's own tone, 50 / 80 / 110 kHz and radio 1's +300 kHz), workspace.ticks.<n>, workspace.r.<n>.running
selecting radio 2 and choosing AGC Fast / the noise blanker: state workspace.r.2.agc and workspace.r.2.nb change, radio 1's do not; selecting radio 1 shows Auto and off again

click "Link tuning": state workspace.link, workspace.linked and the key checked; with it on +10 kHz on radio 1 (Ctrl+Up) moves radios 2 and 3 by +10 kHz, off it moves nobody (state workspace.r.<n>.tuned from the engine); link-limit, link-remove

click "Start together" with every radio stopped: state workspace.r.<n>.running == 1 for all four, the key dead while all run (expect enabled), the spread of the first frames measured (state workspace.together)
click "Link Radio 3": state workspace.link.3 == 0 and workspace.linked, expect the key checked; the radio is not moved by radio 1 and does not move it; clicked again it joins with the gap it has

radio range 2 ... then Ctrl+Up past the limit: state workspace.link.2 == 2 and workspace.intended.2 (what the group wants) while workspace.r.2.tuned stays at the limit; back down, link.2 == 1 and the gap is back

press "STOP ALL", "Radio 8 master", "Controls follow Radio 4", "Link tuning" and "Start together" at 624 x 400, 800 x 560 and 1280 x 720 with six to eight radios: a pointer click at each control's centre (refused outside the window) and the effect read back; bar-tabs: the same on the PATCH and SCOPE tabs
key ctrl+1 .. ctrl+8: state workspace.selected and workspace.page; ctrl+8 with radio 8 not open changes nothing; link-follow selects radio 3 with ctrl+3
key alt+pagedown / alt+pageup: state workspace.page and workspace.cells, clamped at the ends, four pages in Side by side; ctrl+pagedown still retunes the selected radio

the rows are the key table's own: held by test_slint_host_keydispatch (ten rows free, answered, rebound, saved) and test_slint_host_system (listed under "Radio"); the SYSTEM bank's capture is the existing one

seeded with an eight-radio layout and started with one radio: state workspace.layout == 2 with workspace.shown == 0 and the record unchanged (state workspace.savedview); radios added inside ten seconds bring back the saved selection, Link and the splitters; saved-roundtrip writes it and saved-restore reads it back
